Collect REAL U.S. business leads for a sales-prospecting database via genuine web research (NOT generation). Your slice: Columbus, Ohio. Industries: plumbers, HVAC, roofers, electricians, landscapers.

⛔ ABSOLUTE #1 RULE — NEVER fabricate/guess/invent ANY data (business names, emails, phones, addresses, websites, owners, socials). Record ONLY information literally present on a real page you actually fetched with WebFetch. Leave any field BLANK ("") if not publicly available. A missing email is CORRECT; a made-up email is a critical failure. Accuracy > count. Respect site ToS/robots.txt; do NOT bypass anti-bot protections. Prefer official business websites and openly-fetchable public directory listings. If a directory (Yelp, etc.) blocks WebFetch, skip it — do not invent.

METHOD: For each industry, use WebSearch to find real Columbus businesses (e.g. "Columbus Ohio plumber"), then WebFetch each business's own website (and/or a public directory listing) and extract ONLY what's actually shown. Aim for 8-12 REAL businesses total with spread across the 5 industries. Fewer real/verified is better than padded.

For each business capture: businessName, category, subcategory, naics (map confidently else ""), contactFirstName, contactLastName, contactTitle (only if publicly listed/owner shown, else ""), businessEmail (""), generalEmail (only if publicly listed on site), phone, website, address, city, state, zip, linkedin, facebook, instagram (only if actually linked), websiteQuality ("none"/"outdated"/"basic"/"modern"), hasWebsite (true/false), mobileFriendly (responsive viewport meta / mobile CSS best-effort true/false/null), ssl (https loads true/false), onlineBooking (booking widget/link true/false), ecommerce (cart/shop true/false), clearCta (visible contact/quote/book button true/false), leadScore 0-100, leadTier ("Extremely strong" 80-100 = no/broken/very outdated site; "Strong" 60-79 = outdated/weak CTA; "Moderate" 40-59 = functional improvable; "Low" 20-39 = modern/strong; "Very low" 0-19 = excellent), sourceUrl (exact page you took record from — REQUIRED), verificationStatus ("Verified"=own site confirms name+phone, "Partially Verified"=directory confirms only, "Unverified", "Needs Review"), notes.

NAICS hints: plumbers 238220, HVAC 238220, electricians 238210, roofers 238160, landscapers 561730.

OUTPUT: Write a JSON array (only these records) to /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/leads/columbus.json with exactly these keys per record: businessName, category, subcategory, naics, contactFirstName, contactLastName, contactTitle, businessEmail, generalEmail, phone, website, address, city, state, zip, linkedin, facebook, instagram, websiteQuality, hasWebsite, mobileFriendly, ssl, onlineBooking, ecommerce, clearCta, leadScore, leadTier, sourceUrl, verificationStatus, notes. Use blank strings for missing text; true/false/null for booleans.

Return a short summary: how many real records written, industry spread, and any access limits hit.
